reason: Each normative clause maps to a substantive assertion: SPEC.md:156 /healthz 200+body → test_fr09.py:221/232/242; SPEC.md:157 /readyz 503+detail → test_fr09.py:383/396 (migration drift) and 409/415 (DB down), happy-path 200 → 654; SPEC.md:158 /v1/metrics admin-only → test_fr09.py:468, admin-OK 200+payload → 697/713; SPEC.md:160 fail-closed migration → test_fr09.py:396. Each assertion is a real comparison against runtime values, not tautologies.

gaps.message: The AC-9.3 payload assertion is len(body) >= 1, which would pass for any non-empty JSON dict; SPEC.md:158 requires 'task counts by status, execution latency percentiles, rate-limit rejection counts' but the test only pins shape (dict, non-empty) rather than specific field names or content. An implementation returning e.g. {'foo': 'bar'} would satisfy this assertion while violating the substantive contract.
